title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1969-01-24

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a classic early‑1969 set featuring a standout Dupree's Diamond Blues with Pigpen on harmonica.
ai_review.review: All three reviewers rate the show five stars, praising its historic repertoire from Anthem of the Sun and Aoxomoxoa and highlighting Pigpen’s harp (harmonica) on Dupree's Diamond Blues. The recording is described as sounding "just about right," implying a clean, well‑balanced soundboard source. Overall the performance is viewed as a must‑have for any 1969 collection.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently perfect 5‑star reviews emphasize both strong musical content and satisfactory sound quality, yielding a near‑top rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, balanced sound; reviewers note it sounds "just about right" with no reported issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Focuses on material from Anthem of the Sun and Aoxomoxoa, delivering a cohesive early‑1969 vibe.
